title: Plan
intro: The goals for this period, each with a short plan: what we will do, how often, who, how we will know it helps and when we will look again.
sequence: Strength → Need → Adaptation → What we will do → How we will know it helps → Follow-up

guidance.title: Choose 2–3 goals for this period
guidance.body: A few goals, followed closely, help more than many. Up to 3 can be active at a time.
guidance.third: This will be the third goal for this period. 2–3 goals is the most one period can carry well.

full: 3 goals are active. Pause or complete one to add another.
limit: There are already 3 active goals. Pause or complete one first.
noneActiveHint: Choose an area for support from the suggestions or write your own.

columns.label: The plan
columns.title: Goal
columns.success_looks_like: How we will know it helps

editor.title: Edit goal and plan
editor.what_we_will_doHint: The activity or way of working, for example “build the garage together in a pair”.
editor.whoHint: Who leads it, for example “the class teacher and the assistant”.
editor.success_looks_likeHint: Describe what you would see, never a number.
editor.follow_up_onHint: When you will look at this goal again.
editor.strength_usedHint: A strength or interest the plan builds on.
editor.needHint: What the child needs support with, in everyday words.
editor.adaptationHint: What we change around the child.

hopes.title: Family hopes
hopes.hint: What the family hopes for. Suggestions only: you decide the goals.
hopes.develop: What they would like the child to develop
hopes.feel: How they hope the child feels

needs.title: From the teacher observation
needs.hint: Where to focus next, as noted in the teacher observation.

history.title: History of “{title}”
history.backfill: As it was when the history began
